$comment: The Pi upgrade contract matrix (capability agent-harness, Requirement: Pi Upgrades Are Proven Through a Public Contract Harness; change guard-pi-upgrades-with-contract-tests). One group per failure domain, one owner per group, every file in exactly one group. Run one group with `npm run pi:contracts -- --group <name>`; contract-matrix.test.ts keeps this file honest. docs/pi-upgrades.md explains how to read a red group.

construction.owner: packages/pi-bridge/src/session.ts, atomization-session.ts and runtime/pi-config.ts — explicit home/settings/resources, prompt composition, active tool sets per policy

provider.owner: packages/pi-bridge/src/provider.ts and runtime/pi-model.ts — BYO registration on the session's ModelRuntime, reasoning, context window, live and failed re-bind; plus the scripted provider seam itself

lifecycle.owner: packages/pi-bridge/src/runtime/pi-events.ts (settled run bracket), runtime/pi-session-port.ts and turn-stop.ts — chronology, retry, continuation, abort/stop, exactly-once settlement, concurrent sessions; the renderer's finalization consumer

deferred-answer.owner: packages/pi-bridge/src/picker-tool.ts and pending-answer-gate.ts — terminate ends the run, the answer is the next user turn

compaction.owner: packages/pi-bridge/src/compaction-companion-extension.ts and retained-state-handover.ts — direct, steered, failed and bounded compaction on the real Pi pipeline; the handover's host delivery

persistence.owner: packages/pi-bridge/src/session.ts (resume seed, pinned session id) and maturity-replay.ts — both Pi JSONL generations, fail-soft and read-only

security.owner: packages/pi-bridge/src/write-fence.ts, atomization-session.ts and the tool allowlist in session.ts — write/edit fence, no shell, the ephemeral FS-only atomization policy

guards.owner: the repository guards — runtime boundary, private/deep Pi access, installed-package patches, version alignment, direct declarations, and this matrix

outsideContracts.reason: Domain behaviour that happens to run on a real session. These stay in `npm test` and their owners' suites; a Pi upgrade that breaks one shows up there, not as an SDK contract.

scenarios.scenario: Scripted provider exercises the real runtime without network

tests.title: drives thinking, a real tool execution, a retried error and text through real Pi with no request leaving the process
holds a controlled delay open: nothing terminal is emitted until the scripted response is released
the sentinel itself is able to fail: a real fetch or socket connect is recorded and refused
emits nothing terminal, persists no answer and keeps the prompt pending between the low-level end and the retried response
settles exactly once per accepted prompt across consecutive ordinary runs
a stop inside the held retry completes only at settlement and leaves the session continuable
emits one terminal agent_end only after the continued low-level run, through the real runtime
keys each settled end to its own session while two runs overlap
does NOT finalize before the settled agent_end — a retry inside the run keeps the buffer

scenarios.scenario: Deferred-answer tool ends cleanly and accepts the next answer

tests.title: a picker call ends the run — one model round trip, no second turn on the placeholder
two picker round-trips submit their answers cleanly (no continue-from-assistant throw)

scenarios.scenario: Compaction contract drives Pi rather than a fake runner

tests.title: direct: with nothing unmirrored the compaction proceeds unsteered and arms the handover
steered: an unmirrored decision cancels once and re-triggers Pi's compaction with the fenced excerpt
failed: a summary that cannot be produced leaves no handover and the run still settles once
trips the bound on repeated mid-run compactions inside ONE run (no settled reset between them)
the compaction group builds no CompactionResult and copies no token trigger

scenarios.scenario: Persistence contract reads both runtime generations safely

tests.title: rebuilds the reading from old and new legs beside foreign entries, rewrites nothing, and reads only its own pinned legs
reads an old leg and a new leg of one session in chronological order and tolerates 1.x recovery entries
seeds the stored turns into the fresh session's context, in order
refuses a floating or inexact version set before touching anything
a green candidate leaves a clean caller byte-identical and removes its temporary checkout
a green candidate leaves a dirty caller and its lockfile byte-identical
an install failure is reported as install and still cleans up
a build failure is reported as build, not contract, and still cleans up
a contract failure is reported per group and exits non-zero

scenarios.scenario: Contract success does not replace release evidence

tests.title: a green report states what it did not prove
the contract runner names the evidence it does not provide

scenarios.scenario: Private Pi access is rejected mechanically

tests.title: imports `@earendil-works/pi-*` only from approved adapter modules and adapter-level tests
finds no private session-agent access, deep Pi import or adapter-internal reach in the repository
finds no installed-package patch mechanism and no drift in the installed Pi packages
finds the Pi runtime set exactly pinned and aligned in manifests and lockfile
finds every imported runtime/schema package declared directly
every guard fails on its negative fixture
